calculation_handling.description: A group home or residential care home used for correctional purposes may not be on a lot in the RD zone.

calculation_handling.description: A correctional group home or residential care home must be on a lot with a front lot line abutting a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map.
calculation_handling.gaps: The Policy Areas Overlay Map is not held; correctional use is not a scenario input.

150.15.30.1(2).explanation: A group home or residential care home used for correctional purposes must not be in the RD zone and must be on a lot whose front lot line abuts a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map.
